package learningsession

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/curriculum"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const (
	summaryStudentID   = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	summarySessionID   = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	summaryAnalyticsID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	summaryTeacherID   = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	summaryDialogID    = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
)

type summaryTeacherStub struct{}

func (summaryTeacherStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return domain.PersonalTeacher{ID: summaryTeacherID, StudentID: summaryStudentID, Language: "ru"}, nil
}

type summarySessionStub struct {
	session domain.StudentLearningSession
	applied domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary
}

func (stub *summarySessionStub) GetLearningSession(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	return stub.session, nil
}
func (stub *summarySessionStub) ApplyLearningSessionMetrics(_ context.Context, _, _ string, expectedVersion int64, analytics domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	stub.applied = analytics
	stub.session.Version = expectedVersion + 1
	stub.session.ActiveLearningSeconds = analytics.ActiveLearningSeconds
	stub.session.CodeRunCount = analytics.CodeRunCount
	return stub.session, nil
}

type summaryAnalyticsStub struct {
	summary domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary
}

func (stub summaryAnalyticsStub) GetLearningSessionSummary(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary, error) {
	return stub.summary, nil
}

type summaryDialogStub struct{ body string }

func (stub *summaryDialogStub) EnsureTeacherDialog(_ context.Context, studentID, teacherID string, contextType domain.LearningContextType, contextID string) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	return domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: summaryDialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: contextType, ContextID: contextID}, nil
}

type summaryCurriculumStub struct {
	called bool
	result curriculum.PlanResult
}

func (stub *summaryCurriculumStub) ExecuteCurrent(
	_ context.Context, studentID, courseID, triggerID string, audit curriculum.PlanAuditRefs,
) (curriculum.PlanResult, error) {
	stub.called = true
	return stub.result, nil
}
func (stub *summaryDialogStub) AppendTeacherProactive(_ context.Context, _ domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	stub.body = body
	return domain.DialogMessage{ID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"}, nil
}

func TestSummarizerPersistsBoundedMetricsAndGeneralDialogSummary(t *testing.T) {
	ended := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 19, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	sessions := &summarySessionStub{session: domain.StudentLearningSession{
		ID: summarySessionID, StudentID: summaryStudentID, AnalyticsSessionID: summaryAnalyticsID,
		CourseID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Version: 2, EndedAt: &ended,
	}}
	analytics := domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{
		AnalyticsSessionID: summaryAnalyticsID, StudentID: summaryStudentID,
		StartedAt: ended.Add(-30 * time.Minute), LastActivityAt: ended, WallClockSeconds: 1800,
		ActiveLearningSeconds: 1200, LessonCount: 1, TaskCount: 2, QuestionCount: 3,
		CodeRunCount: 5, FailureCount: 4, PassedTestCount: 2, HintCount: 1, StuckSignalCount: 1,
		PolicyVersion: "learning-analytics-active-time-v1",
	}
	dialogs := &summaryDialogStub{}
	curriculumPlanner := &summaryCurriculumStub{result: curriculum.PlanResult{
		RequestID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", GoalCode: "go.backend", Status: "PLANNING",
	}}
	result, err := (Summarizer{
		Teachers: summaryTeacherStub{}, Sessions: sessions, Analytics: summaryAnalyticsStub{summary: analytics}, Dialogs: dialogs,
		Curriculum: curriculumPlanner,
	}).Execute(context.Background(), summaryStudentID, summarySessionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1200, sessions.applied.ActiveLearningSeconds)
	require.Equal(t, int64(3), result.Session.Version)
	require.Equal(t, "stuck_or_failure_review", result.ReasonCode)
	require.Contains(t, dialogs.body, "20 активных минут")
	require.Contains(t, dialogs.body, "повтори сложный шаг")
	require.True(t, curriculumPlanner.called)
	require.Equal(t, "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", result.PlanningRequestID)
}

func TestSummarizerRequiresEndedStudentSession(t *testing.T) {
	sessions := &summarySessionStub{session: domain.StudentLearningSession{
		ID: summarySessionID, StudentID: summaryStudentID, AnalyticsSessionID: summaryAnalyticsID, Version: 1,
	}}
	_, err := (Summarizer{
		Teachers: summaryTeacherStub{}, Sessions: sessions, Analytics: summaryAnalyticsStub{}, Dialogs: &summaryDialogStub{}, Curriculum: &summaryCurriculumStub{},
	}).Execute(context.Background(), summaryStudentID, summarySessionID)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLearningSessionSummary)
}
